title: Click chemistry-modified cardiomyocytes enhance cardiac contractility and prevent remodeling in ischemia-reperfusion injured hearts

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】One of the challenges in cardiac cell therapy using cardiomyocytes derived from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSC-CMs) is their poor engraftment and survival rate in infarcted tissues.
